limitations: Only the unrestricted four-independent-neighborhood signed membership semantics is proved, not frame-restricted extensions or global consequence.
The 2k-1 bound is sharp for simultaneous signed operand-trace separation, not established optimal for all equivalent pointed models.
Random finite verifier trials do not establish arbitrary-cardinality statements; the latter follow from the trace lemma and signed induction.
The abstract coNP complexity class occurs already in classical nonnormal modal logic, but the explicit linear signed-trace construction and certificate for these weak-negation clauses are the focus.
Published literature comparisons cannot exclude unknown equivalent results under general filtration or multi-sorted translation terminology.
